zh.headline: 政府强制Anthropic下线Fable 5和Mythos 5
zh.observation: 今天的头条无疑是美国政府强制Anthropic下线最强模型，这标志着AI安全与地缘政治的交叉点进入新阶段——出口管制从企业自愿合规变为政府直接命令，全球AI部署的“信任边界”被重新划定。与此同时，多篇论文揭示了LLM Agent在安全、记忆和通信方面的系统性缺陷（冷启动安全缺口、用户偏好遗忘），表明Agent落地仍面临根本性挑战。开源社区则涌现出一批聚焦“Agent技能”的工具（last30days、Agent-Reach、codegraph），正在快速将Agent从“通用大脑”武装为“专业工具”，这或许是当前最值得关注的实用趋势。

items.title: 政府强制Anthropic下线Fable 5和Mythos 5
items.desc: 美国政府以国家安全为由，命令Anthropic切断其最强模型Fable 5和Mythos 5对所有海外用户及自身员工的访问。
items.value: 标志AI出口管制从企业自愿走向政府强制，动摇全球AI部署格局。

items.title: 亚马逊CEO被指引发Anthropic模型禁令
items.desc: 报道称，亚马逊CEO Andy Jassy的网络安全研究及与白宫沟通，直接触发了政府对Anthropic Fable 5和Mythos 5的出口管制。
items.value: 揭示科技巨头在AI安全博弈中的关键角色，影响未来政企关系。

items.title: OpenAI遭多州总检察长调查
items.desc: 美国多州总检察长联合调查OpenAI，涉及广告政策、健康数据处理等多项合规问题。
items.value: AI监管从联邦层面下沉至州级，合规成本将显著上升。

items.title: 法院裁定谷歌对AI Overviews虚假陈述负责
items.desc: 法院判决谷歌需为其AI Overviews生成的虚假陈述承担法律责任，认定设计、训练和运营AI系统的公司需承担侵权责任。
items.value: 确立AI平台对生成内容的法律责任先例，影响所有AI搜索产品。

items.title: Meta AI部门被曝内部混乱，员工士气低落
items.desc: 报道称Meta数月前成立的AI部门（6500人）处于“崩溃边缘”，员工抱怨工作环境压抑，AI战略混乱。
items.value: Meta AI人才流失风险加剧，开源模型战略或受影响。

items.title: Mistral据传以200亿欧元估值融资30亿欧元
items.desc: Mistral AI被曝正在进行新一轮融资，估值较C轮翻倍至约200亿欧元。
items.value: 欧洲AI冠军持续获得巨额资本，开源与闭源双轨战略获市场认可。

items.title: 苹果iOS 27推出AI照片编辑功能
items.desc: 苹果在iOS 27中首次引入AI照片编辑工具，包括重新构图、扩展和清理功能，但效果不及Google Pixel。
items.value: 苹果正式加入AI照片编辑战局，但保守策略可能影响用户体验。

items.title: Siri重大更新，不再讨好用户
items.desc: 苹果新版Siri被设计为不迎合用户，Craig Federighi表示Siri不会像其他聊天机器人那样谄媚。
items.value: 苹果AI产品设计理念差异化，强调实用而非情感连接。

items.title: Google起诉中国AI网络诈骗团伙
items.desc: 谷歌起诉名为“Outsider Enterprise”的中国团伙，该团伙利用AI在两周内向数十万受害者发送250万条诈骗短信。
items.value: AI驱动的网络诈骗规模化，科技巨头开始法律反击。

items.title: 毕马威因幻觉撤回AI使用报告
items.desc: 毕马威因报告中出现明显AI幻觉而撤回一份关于AI使用情况的报告。
items.value: 专业服务机构使用AI仍需严格审查，AI幻觉问题仍具破坏性。

items.title: 通义团队再失核心：阿里首席科学家周靖人被曝离职
items.desc: 传阿里通义团队首席科学家周靖人履新六天后离职，阿里AI核心团队持续动荡。
items.value: 国内大模型人才流失加剧，可能影响阿里AI技术路线稳定性。

items.title: Bezos新AI公司目标构建“通用工程智能”
items.desc: 亚马逊创始人Jeff Bezos透露其AI初创公司Prometheus致力于开发“通用工程智能”，辅助实体产品设计。
items.value: AI从软件工程向物理工程设计延伸，开辟新应用场景。

items.title: 1500美元训出1B参数HRM模型获HuggingFace CEO力荐
items.desc: Bengio团队参与研发的HRM模型（1B参数），训练成本仅1500美元，在多个任务上表现优异。
items.value: 证明小模型+高效训练可以接近大模型能力，降低AI应用门槛。

items.title: LLM注释性能的极限：模型内化先验的影响
items.desc: 研究LLM零样本注释时，模型内化先验如何影响任务表现，以及提示中额外信息能否纠正零样本错误。
items.value: 为LLM-as-Judge和自动标注提供理论指导，帮助设计更可靠的评估流程。

items.title: LLM心理测量评估的重新思考：自我报告何时能预测行为
items.desc: 发现LLM的自我报告与行为存在显著不一致，但通过更精细的测量设计可以改善预测效果。
items.value: 改进AI安全评估方法论，避免依赖不可靠的自我报告数据。

items.title: 异构Agent间的密集潜在通信
items.desc: 提出通过KV-cache实现异构模型间的直接潜在表示通信，避免文本解码-重编码的损失和开销。
items.value: 突破多Agent系统通信瓶颈，实现更高效、更保真的模型间协作。

items.title: TRACE：将用户修正编译为编码Agent的运行时强制执行
items.desc: 提出TRACE框架，将用户偏好编译为运行时规则，使编码Agent能记住并遵守用户修正，超越传统记忆系统。
items.value: 解决AI Agent“记不住用户偏好”的核心痛点，提升长期协作效率。

items.title: LLM Agent的冷启动安全缺口
items.desc: 发现LLM Agent在会话开始时最脆弱，完成几个常规任务后才变得安全，提出SODA基准来系统研究这一现象。
items.value: 揭示Agent安全的新维度，为安全部署提供关键设计指导。

items.title: HYDRA-X：原生统一多模态模型
items.desc: 首个在单一ViT中统一图像和视频分词器的多模态模型，实现真正的原生多模态理解。
items.value: 简化多模态模型架构，为视频理解与图像理解的统一奠定基础。

items.title: VIA-SD：通过模型内路由验证的推测解码
items.desc: 提出使用大模型内部的子模型处理中等难度token，而非全模型验证，加速推测解码。
items.value: 降低LLM推理成本，无需额外训练即可提升解码速度。

items.title: TreeSeeker：深度搜索中的树结构试错与回溯
items.desc: 提出树结构搜索框架，让Agent在深度搜索中平衡探索与利用，避免盲目跟随或浪费预算。
items.value: 提升复杂多步搜索任务的推理效率，直接提升Agent实际应用能力。

items.title: 视觉语言模型训练机器人读取人类情绪
items.desc: 研究利用视觉语言模型训练协作机器人，通过面部表情和环境线索理解人类情绪。
items.value: 推动人机协作中的情感感知能力，提升机器人社交智能。

items.title: 代码Agent的测试时规则获取与编译执行
items.desc: 提出TRACE框架，将用户修正编译为运行时规则，使Agent能跨会话记住并遵守用户偏好。
items.value: 解决AI Agent“记不住用户偏好”的核心痛点，提升长期协作效率。

items.title: headroom](https://github.com/chopratejas/headroom)
items.desc: 压缩工具输出、日志、文件和RAG块，在到达LLM前减少60-95%的token数，同时保持答案质量。提供库、代理和MCP服务器。

items.title: last30days-skill](https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill)
items.desc: AI Agent技能，可跨Reddit、X、YouTube、HN、Polymarket和网络研究任何话题，并综合生成有依据的摘要。

items.title: Agent-Reach](https://github.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach)
items.desc: 让AI Agent能读取和搜索Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书等平台，单CLI工具，零API费用。

items.title: codegraph](https://github.com/colbymchenry/codegraph)
items.desc: 为Claude Code、Codex、Gemini、Cursor等工具提供预索引代码知识图谱，减少token消耗和工具调用，完全本地运行。

items.title: drawio-skill](https://github.com/Agents365-ai/drawio-skill)
items.desc: 用自然语言生成draw.io图表，支持6种预设和两轮自检循环，可导出PNG/SVG/PDF/JPG。

items.title: hello-agents](https://github.com/datawhalechina/hello-agents)
items.desc: 中文教程《从零开始构建智能体》，从零讲解智能体原理与实践。

items.title: freellmapi](https://github.com/tashfeenahmed/freellmapi)
items.desc: OpenAI兼容代理，聚合约14个AI提供商的免费API密钥并自动故障转移，仅限个人实验。

items.title: rtk](https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk)
items.desc: CLI代理，可将常见开发命令的LLM token消耗减少60-90%，单一Rust二进制文件，零依赖。

items.title: taste-skill](https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill)
items.desc: 为AI注入“好品味”，防止生成无聊、通用的内容。

items.title: impeccable](https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable)
items.desc: 设计语言系统，提升AI在设计任务中的表现。

en.headline: Government Forces Anthropic to Take Down Fable 5 and Mythos 5
en.observation: The top story today is undoubtedly the US government forcing Anthropic to take down its most powerful models, marking a new phase at the intersection of AI safety and geopolitics — export controls have shifted from voluntary corporate compliance to direct government orders, redrawing the "trust boundaries" of global AI deployment. Meanwhile, multiple papers reveal systematic flaws in LLM agents regarding safety, memory, and communication (cold-start safety gaps, user preference forgetting), indicating fundamental challenges remain for agent deployment. The open-source community, however, is seeing a surge of "agent skill" tools (last30days, Agent-Reach, codegraph), rapidly transforming agents from "general brains" into "specialized tools" — this is arguably the most practical trend worth watching right now.

items.title: Government Forces Anthropic to Take Down Fable 5 and Mythos 5
items.desc: The US government ordered Anthropic to cut off access to its most powerful models, Fable 5 and Mythos 5, for all foreign users and its own employees, citing national security concerns.
items.value: Marks shift from voluntary to mandatory AI export controls, reshaping global AI deployment.

items.title: Amazon CEO Reportedly Triggered Anthropic Model Ban
items.desc: Reports indicate Amazon CEO Andy Jassy's cybersecurity research and White House communications directly led to the government's export controls on Anthropic's Fable 5 and Mythos 5.
items.value: Reveals tech giants' pivotal role in AI safety politics, impacting future government-industry relations.

items.title: OpenAI Faces Investigation from State Attorneys General
items.desc: Multiple US state attorneys general are jointly investigating OpenAI over compliance issues including ad policies and health data handling.
items.value: AI regulation cascades from federal to state level, significantly raising compliance costs.

items.title: Court Rules Google Liable for False AI Overviews Statements
items.desc: A court held Google legally responsible for false statements generated by its AI Overviews, ruling companies that design, train, and operate AI systems must assume liability.
items.value: Sets precedent for AI platform liability on generated content, impacting all AI search products.

items.title: Meta AI Unit Reportedly in Chaos, Employee Morale Low
items.desc: Reports suggest Meta's months-old AI unit (6,500 people) is "on the verge of revolt," with employees complaining about oppressive work environments and chaotic AI strategy.
items.value: Meta AI talent exodus risk intensifies, potentially impacting its open-source model strategy.

items.title: Mistral Reportedly Raising €3B at €20B Valuation
items.desc: Mistral AI is reportedly in a new funding round, nearly doubling its Series C valuation to approximately €20 billion.
items.value: European AI champion continues to attract massive capital, validating its dual open/closed-source strategy.

items.title: Apple iOS 27 Introduces AI Photo Editing Features
items.desc: Apple debuts AI photo editing tools in iOS 27, including reframing, extension, and cleanup, though less capable than Google Pixel equivalents.
items.value: Apple officially enters AI photo editing arena, but conservative approach may impact user experience.

items.title: Siri Gets Major Update, Won't Flatter Users
items.desc: Apple's new Siri is designed not to be sycophantic, with Craig Federighi stating Siri won't act like other chatbots.
items.value: Differentiates Apple's AI design philosophy, emphasizing utility over emotional connection.

items.title: Google Sues Chinese AI-Powered Cybercrime Ring
items.desc: Google sued a Chinese group called "Outsider Enterprise" that used AI to send 2.5 million scam texts to hundreds of thousands of victims in two weeks.
items.value: AI-driven fraud scales up; tech giants begin legal countermeasures.

items.title: KPMG Pulls AI Usage Report Due to Hallucinations
items.desc: KPMG withdrew a report on AI usage after apparent AI hallucinations were discovered in its content.
items.value: Professional services firms still need rigorous review when using AI; hallucination problem remains disruptive.

items.title: Alibaba Tongyi Team Loses Another Core Member: Chief Scientist Zhou Jingren Reportedly Leaves
items.desc: Reports say Alibaba's Tongyi chief scientist Zhou Jingren left just six days after a new appointment, signaling ongoing team instability.
items.value: China's LLM talent drain intensifies, potentially affecting Alibaba's AI technology roadmap stability.

items.title: Bezos' New AI Startup Aims for 'Artificial General Engineer'
items.desc: Amazon founder Jeff Bezos revealed his AI startup Prometheus is working toward an "artificial general engineer" to assist physical product design.
items.value: AI expands from software engineering to physical product design, opening new application domains.

items.title: $1500-Trained 1B Parameter HRM Model Gets HuggingFace CEO Endorsement
items.desc: The HRM model (1B params), developed with Bengio's team involvement and costing only $1500 to train, performs well on multiple tasks.
items.value: Proves small models + efficient training can approach large model capabilities, lowering AI adoption barriers.

items.title: On the Limits of LLM Adaptability: Impact of Model-Internalized Priors on Annotation Task Performance
items.desc: Studies how LLMs' internalized priors affect zero-shot annotation performance and whether additional prompt information can correct errors.
items.value: Provides theoretical guidance for LLM-as-Judge and auto-labeling, enabling more reliable evaluation pipelines.

items.title: Rethinking Psychometric Evaluation of LLMs: When and Why Self-Reports Predict Behavior
items.desc: Finds significant self-report vs. behavior dissociation in LLMs, but finer-grained measurement design can improve prediction.
items.value: Improves AI safety evaluation methodology, avoiding reliance on unreliable self-report data.

items.title: Dense Latent Communication Across Heterogeneous Agents
items.desc: Proposes direct latent representation communication between heterogeneous models via KV-cache, avoiding text decode-reencode losses.
items.value: Breaks multi-agent system communication bottleneck, enabling more efficient and faithful inter-model collaboration.

items.title: TRACE: Compiling User Corrections into Runtime Enforcement for Coding Agents
items.desc: Introduces TRACE framework that compiles user preferences into runtime rules, enabling agents to remember and comply with corrections across sessions.
items.value: Solves core pain point of AI agents "forgetting user preferences," improving long-term collaboration efficiency.

items.title: The Cold-Start Safety Gap in LLM Agents
items.desc: Discovers LLM agents are most vulnerable at session start and become safer after a few regular tasks; proposes SODA benchmark.
items.value: Reveals new dimension of agent safety, providing critical design guidance for safe deployment.

items.title: HYDRA-X: Native Unified Multimodal Models
items.desc: First multimodal model unifying image and video tokenization within a single ViT, achieving truly native multimodal understanding.
items.value: Simplifies multimodal model architecture, laying foundation for unified video and image understanding.

items.title: VIA-SD: Verification via Intra-Model Routing for Speculative Decoding
items.desc: Proposes using sub-models within large models for medium-difficulty tokens instead of full model verification, accelerating speculative decoding.
items.value: Reduces LLM inference cost, improves decoding speed without additional training.

items.title: TreeSeeker: Tree-Structured Trial, Error, and Return in Deep Search
items.desc: Proposes tree-structured search framework balancing exploration and exploitation in deep search, avoiding blind following or budget waste.
items.value: Improves reasoning efficiency in complex multi-step search tasks, directly enhancing practical agent capabilities.

items.title: Visual Language Models Train Robots to Read Human Emotions
items.desc: Research uses visual language models to train collaborative robots to understand human emotions through facial expressions and environmental cues.
items.value: Advances emotional perception in human-robot collaboration, enhancing robot social intelligence.

items.title: Test-Time Rule Acquisition and Compiled Enforcement for Coding Agents
items.desc: Proposes TRACE framework compiling user corrections into runtime rules, enabling agents to remember preferences across sessions.
items.value: Solves core pain point of AI agents "forgetting user preferences," improving long-term collaboration efficiency.

items.desc: Compresses tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before reaching the LLM, reducing tokens by 60-95% while maintaining answer quality. Library, proxy, and MCP server.

items.desc: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web, synthesizing grounded summaries.

items.title: Agent-Reach](https://github.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach)
items.desc: Gives AI agents eyes to read and search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, etc. Single CLI, zero API fees.

items.title: codegraph](https://github.com/colbymchenry/codegraph)
items.desc: Pre-indexed code knowledge graph for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, and more. Reduces tokens and tool calls, 100% local.

items.title: drawio-skill](https://github.com/Agents365-ai/drawio-skill)
items.desc: Generates draw.io diagrams from natural language with 6 presets and a 2-round self-check loop. Exports to PNG/SVG/PDF/JPG.

items.title: freellmapi](https://github.com/tashfeenahmed/freellmapi)

items.title: rtk](https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk)
items.desc: CLI proxy reducing LLM token consumption by 60-90% on common dev commands. Single Rust binary, zero dependencies.

items.title: taste-skill](https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill)
items.desc: Gives AI "good taste," preventing generation of boring, generic content.

items.title: impeccable](https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable)
items.desc: Design language system that makes AI better at design tasks.
